about: Gold risk labels for the sample documents. Each label names a category and an 'anchor': a short exact substring that identifies the clause. A predicted flag matches a label when it has the same category and its clause contains the anchor. Split 'dev' was used while writing the rules; 'test' was written afterwards in different wording and not used for tuning.
